summary: DuplicateHandle as mono calls it: the pseudo-handles -1 and -2 become real handles, new ones each time, naming the current process and thread; a thread's handle does not signal while it runs; a duplicate of an event names the same event, and with DUPLICATE_CLOSE_SOURCE takes the source's value; a source that is no handle: FALSE, 6, the target NULL; success leaves the last error. OpenThread on the current thread's id gives a real handle, on an id no thread has NULL and 87. CreateSemaphoreW sets error 0 on success; an initial count above the maximum is NULL and 87.
applicability: windows-2022 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor); windows-2025 (AMD EPYC 9V45 96-Core Processor)

initial.process: started by the runner's cmd with standard output redirected

evidence.quote: DUPLICATE_CLOSE_SOURCE: Closes the source handle. This occurs regardless of any error status returned.

open_questions: One thread runs in w2m: OpenThread answers only the current thread's id, and waiting without a timeout on a running thread stops the run.
Windows reuses a closed handle's value; w2m gives a CLOSE_SOURCE copy the source's slot and otherwise the lowest free slot. Which value a later handle gets is not in the rows.
